fixed_method.label: coarse_corrected_pod
fixed_method.coarse_basis: Fixed real low-stiffness eigenmodes of the existing fine-grid K operator; no fresh-model fitting or rank tuning
fixed_method.proposal: One fixed coarse defect correction to the POD physical state and recomputed physical adjoint. Build the physical approximate gradient from the corrected state/adjoint; no claim this is AD of the corrected-state objective.
fixed_method.direction: For each original model, normalize minus the SUM of all four physical approximate block gradients at the identical shared smoothed m. Use this SAME direction in every block certificate.
fixed_method.aggregate_certificate: Sum the four signed physical approximate directional derivatives and the four nonnegative deterministic residual error bounds at that shared direction. Report upper derivative and certified descent only when every block is available.
fixed_method.unavailable_policy: If any frequency stability certificate is unavailable, retain raw POD fields/proposal for its blocks and report correction_skipped. Retain every model outcome and quality/cost. Aggregate available=false, certified_descent=false, exact_fallback_required=true, total bound and certified upper derivative=null. No online exact recovery is executed by this evaluator.
fixed_method.zero_or_nonfinite: Preserve explicit abstention; zero aggregate gradient yields no strict certified descent. Nonfinite computation fails the attempt with all completed raw outcomes retained; no silent clipping into a passing value.

prospective_cohort: Exactly the existing fresh100 indices per family from each fixed400 complement; all4 source/frequency blocks retained per original index. No resampling, new models, family pooling, source/frequency change or fresh-data fit.
staging: No fifth-model prediction until root reviews the public additive coarse-stability/certificate modules and a NEW immutable fifth-comparator freeze binds their exact source manifest, numerical runtime, fixed method parameters, selected POD basis, original StageB/StageC/POD freezes, and this addendum. All five labels and both families must be retained. Existing source/calibration/results remain immutable.
source_calibration: Not evaluated for this fifth method. No FNO or uncorrected-POD calibration scale is transferred. This is a deterministic aggregate residual certificate; any later statistical calibration requires a separate explicit prospective protocol and dedicated freeze.

reporting.cost: All online state/adjoint reduced solves, coarse setup/factorization/correction/residual/operator/norm work recorded. Exact held-out validation work separate; no exact online-recovery costs fabricated. No inference-to-inversion speedup extrapolation.
